description: The traveler's Dreamfare account snapshot: profile, membership tier, Stardust credits, and wallet balance (commission earned through tracked bookings). Reading also initializes or reconciles membership and credit allowance records: expired membership can end, the monthly credit period can roll, and the grant can change with the tier. This does not spend credits, purchase travel, or change the wallet balance. Returns data plus display.resultId; call display_card to show it. presentation (optional) shapes what is shown without changing the action: compact or full layout, and only the limit, ids or sections this tool advertises.

layout.description: Compact cards or the full view; keeps booking, add and error actions available.

sections.description: Show only these optional sections. Identity and essential actions remain available; omit to keep the full view.

name: get_profile
title: Read the traveler's account
